web.wedoRespectsYourPrivacyThisPolicyExp: WeDo respects your privacy. This policy explains the information collected through our mobile app and services, how it is used and how it is protected.
web.yourEmailAddressDisplayNameAndASalte: Your email address, display name and a salted password hash for password-based accounts.
web.whenYouSignUpWithEmailWeSend: When you sign up with email, we send a time-limited code through Resend. A secure digest, expiry and attempt information are stored on the server to protect your account.
web.googleProvidesYourUserIdentifierVeri: Google provides your user identifier, verified email address and profile name for account creation and sign-in verification. We do not receive your Google password or request access to Gmail, Drive or Calendar.
web.yourAppleUserIdentifierAndTheNameAnd: Your Apple user identifier and the name and email you choose to share are used to manage your account and sessions. Hide My Email is supported. We securely store an encrypted Apple refresh token to manage and revoke this connection. Apple account-change notifications update your sign-in and email forwarding status. If revocation temporarily fails after account deletion, the encrypted token is retained until revocation succeeds.
web.theEmailAddressAndOptionalDescriptio: The email address and optional description you provide are sent to our support inbox to assess your request and verify account ownership.
web.linksMemoryPhotosVotesAndReactionsAd: Links, memory photos, votes and reactions added to shared lists.
web.expoPushNotificationTokensUsedToNoti: Expo push notification tokens used to notify you of activity in shared spaces.
web.yourInformationIsNotSoldOrSharedFor: Your information is not sold or shared for advertising or profiling. Communication between the app and our service is encrypted using HTTPS/TLS.
web.googleOrAppleProvidesAuthenticationW: Google or Apple provides authentication when you choose that sign-in method. Web support requests, including your email address and description, are sent through Resend to our Google Workspace support inbox.
web.forQuestionsAboutYourPrivacyContact: For questions about your privacy, contact:
web.byDownloadingOrUsingTheWedoAppYou: By downloading or using the WeDo app, you agree to these terms.
web.youMustNotUseTheAppForUnlawful: You must not use the app for unlawful purposes, harassment, abuse or activities that threaten the security of our service.
web.youAreResponsibleForTheLinksAndImage: You are responsible for the links and images you add to shared spaces.
web.wedoMayUpdateTheseTermsOrSuspendAcco: WeDo may update these terms or suspend accounts that violate them.
web.useThisFormToRequestAccountDeletionE: Use this form to request account deletion even if the app is no longer on your device. Your request is emailed to support; this form does not automatically delete your account.
web.onceOwnershipIsVerifiedAndDeletionIs: Once ownership is verified and deletion is completed:
web.yourRegisteredEmailAddressAndNameAre: Your registered email address and name are anonymised.
web.devicePushNotificationTokensAreDelet: Device push notification tokens are deleted from our database.
web.contentRemainingInSharedSpacesIsAttr: Content remaining in shared spaces is attributed to an anonymised account. This form does not automatically remove all shared content.
web.ifYouUsedAppleSHideMyEmail: If you used Apple's Hide My Email, enter the account email shown in the app. You can include an email we can reach you at in the description.
web.enableJavascriptToSendARequestOrEmai: Enable JavaScript to send a request, or email contact@durangezer.com.
web.optionalDescriptionDoNotIncludeYourP: Optional description. Do not include your password.
web.formFailed: We couldn't confirm delivery. Try again or email contact@durangezer.com. This form has not deleted your account.
web.deletionFailed: We couldn't send your request. Try again or email contact@durangezer.com.
web.deletionReceived: Your request has been sent to support. It will be reviewed after account ownership is verified.
